parameters.name: ChildNick
parameters.description: The display name. This name is shown on the page to help you identify the use case of the account.

parameters.name: ChildUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the member account.

parameters.name: ParentUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: PermissionCodes
parameters.description:
The permissions that can be modified. Valid values:

- SYNCHRONIZE\_FINANCE\_IDENTITY: Allow synchronizing the credit control identity with the linked account.

- SYNCHRONIZE\_FINANCE\_DISCOUNT\_POLICY\_TO\_TARGET: Allow synchronizing discounts with the linked account.

- FORBID\_WITHDRAW\_CASH: Prohibit the linked account from withdrawing its balance.

- FORBID\_MANAGE\_INVOICE: Prohibit the linked account from managing invoices.

- CHECK\_FINANCE\_INFO: View information about the account linking relationship.

- MANAGE\_TARGET\_INVOICE: Manage invoices for the linked account.

- CHECK\_TARGET\_CONSUMPTION: View the consumption details of the linked account.

parameters.name: RelationId
parameters.description: The relationship ID. Obtain this value from the relationId field returned by the QueryRelationList operation.

parameters.name: RelationOperation
parameters.description:
The action to perform. Valid values:

- ADD: Adds the permission.

- DELETE: Deletes the permission.

parameters.name: RelationType
parameters.description: The relationship type. Currently, only enterprise\_group is supported.

parameters.name: RequestId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the request. This ID is used to mark a request and troubleshoot issues.
